rules.name: User temporary files
rules.description: Leftovers in your personal temp folder (%TEMP%), typically created by installers and applications. Programs recreate what they need.

rules.name: Windows temporary files
rules.description: Leftovers in the shared Windows temp folder (%WINDIR%\Temp).

rules.name: Windows Update download cache
rules.description: Update installers cached under %WINDIR%\SoftwareDistribution\Download. Windows re-downloads anything it still needs, so this is safe to empty.

rules.name: Prefetch data
rules.description: Prefetch traces in %WINDIR%\Prefetch that Windows uses to speed up program launches. Windows rebuilds them, but expect slightly slower first launches after cleaning.

rules.name: Thumbnail cache
rules.description: Explorer's thumbnail cache databases in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer. Thumbnails are rebuilt automatically as you browse folders.

rules.name: Crash dumps
rules.description: Application and kernel crash dumps in %LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps, %WINDIR%\Minidump and %WINDIR%\LiveKernelReports. Frees space, but discards crash evidence you may want for debugging.

rules.name: Windows error reports
rules.description: Queued and archived Windows Error Reporting data under %PROGRAMDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\WER.

rules.name: Recycle Bin
rules.description: Empties the Recycle Bin on all drives through the Windows Shell API. This permanently deletes everything currently in the bin; WinClean never deletes the bin's on-disk folders manually.

rules.name: Google Chrome caches
rules.description: Chrome's temporary caches for all local browser profiles. Cookies, passwords, browsing history, open sessions and extensions are never touched.

rules.name: Microsoft Edge caches
rules.description: Edge's temporary caches for all local browser profiles. Cookies, passwords, browsing history, open sessions and extensions are never touched.

rules.name: Mozilla Firefox caches
rules.description: Firefox's temporary caches for all local browser profiles. Cookies, passwords, browsing history, open sessions and extensions are never touched.
